function.name: calculator
function.description: Evaluate an arithmetic expression. Supports +, -, *, /, parentheses and powers.

expression.description: The arithmetic expression to evaluate, for example 2 + 2.

precision.description: Number of decimal places to round the result to.

function.name: github
function.description: Search GitHub repositories and issues. Returns matching items with their URLs.

query.description: Search terms, for example a repository or issue title.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return.

function.name: weather
function.description: Get the current weather and the forecast for a location. Temperatures are in Celsius unless units is set.

location.description: City name, for example Oslo or Paris.

days.description: Number of forecast days to include.
